column1: # The scenarios of tests/qemu/run.sh, one per line, in tab-separated columns:
#   name         the name, which run.sh takes as an argument
#   drivers      UEFI drivers on the ESP that the firmware loads before the kernel, in
#                order and separated by ";": a path, then optionally " " and its argument
#   variables    UEFI variables to create first: a JSON file of tests/qemu/vars in the
#   boots        the boots, separated by ",", which share one UEFI variable store: each is a
#                test binary of tests/qemu/guest/tests, then "/" and a libtest filter if any
